comment: The questions no dataset in this repo can answer, written by hand.
Everything else in the bank is derived and cannot rot. These can, so the rules are strict:
a question here must be about something that does not change (a fact of history, geography or
spelling), never about who holds an office, what a population is, or anything else a newspaper
could make wrong. `subject` is the country code the question is about, which is what the
leaderboard weighting draws on; leave it out for a question about nowhere in particular.
`wrong` carries five, of which a round shows two.

questions.subject: rs
questions.text: Does Yugoslavia still exist?
questions.answer: No, it broke up in the 1990s
wrong: Yes, it is in the Balkans
Yes, but it was renamed Slovenia
Yes, it is a member of the EU
No, it became part of Russia
